---
name: code-review
description: Perform a structured senior-level review for correctness, security, maintainability, performance, testing, and regressions.
---

# Code Review Skill

1. Understand the change and intended behavior.
2. Inspect surrounding code and existing patterns.
3. Check correctness and edge cases.
4. Check security and data exposure.
5. Check error handling.
6. Check performance and resource usage.
7. Check maintainability and architecture.
8. Check tests and missing coverage.
9. Report actionable findings with severity and file locations.
10. Avoid style-only comments unless they affect project conventions or maintainability.
